name: @chethandvg/audio-safety-math
description: Decibel arithmetic, noise-dose rules and loudness metering in Rust, Python and WebAssembly, with Lean 4 proofs of the dose rule.
author: Chethan Dandebala Venkatarama

scripts.build: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target nodejs --out-dir pkg/node target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/audio_safety_math_wasm.wasm && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir pkg/web target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/audio_safety_math_wasm.wasm
